correctness.rationale: The deleted-clique Laplacian equals N I-dd^T on the zero-sum subspace, yielding an exact rank-one pseudoinverse. Direct calculation of all edge-orbit current differences proves incident and remote cut-column norms; subtraction of twice the diagonal gives the cycle-column norms. The differences factor exactly at orders 4 and 6. The tree case N=3 is separate. 210 exact rational independently reconstructed columns for N=3..11 agree. The infinite claim rests on algebra, not enumeration.

value.rationale: One missing edge in a clique is a canonical minimal perturbation of a maximally symmetric graph. The exact all-order classification uncovers a two-order delay between changes in cut and cycle endpoint norms and identifies the distinct maximizing-edge transitions. It is a natural complete infinite-family operator-norm phase diagram, not just a one-off computed number or a routine special case of a covered result.
